legacy_columns.name: Architecture Description
legacy_columns.note: Adds RAG extension and preserves pathway inconsistency.

disagreement_records.old: Theoretical only: an LLM extracts organ, modality, and suspected pathology, routes to a task-specific binary classifier, then a positive result may trigger a subtype/severity classifier; pathways end in physician review and confirmatory testing.
disagreement_records.proposed: Theoretical routing/cascade extended by RAG and fit alerts. Physician review intended; negative path explicitly ends at clinical correlation. Guard enforcement unspecified; no world transition or operating evaluation.
disagreement_records.reason: Adds RAG extension and preserves pathway inconsistency.

disagreement_records.old: The authors' combinatorial model estimates 50,000–150,000+ distinct task-specific classifiers for subspecialty-level diagnostic coverage; this is a theoretical estimate, not an implemented model result.
disagreement_records.proposed: Headline 50,000–150,000+ retained alongside Table 9 binary scenarios, Equation (8) approximately 170,000, and Table 13 cascaded scenarios. Counts have unresolved arithmetic/unit issues and are not clinical-performance results.
disagreement_records.reason: Avoids treating differently scoped counts as interchangeable.

disagreement_records.old: The classifier-count analysis and proposed routing architectures are theoretical; the paper does not implement or evaluate a learned/hybrid state-transition model, action-conditioned forecasts, counterfactual rollouts, or planning/control.
disagreement_records.proposed: No own operative WM or clinical evaluation. Secondary studies do not transfer readiness. Count scenarios are not universal lower bounds; prognostic framing, alerts, and oversight do not establish safety, causality, or benefit.

scope_choices: Automated model review, not independent human verification, replication, clinical validation, or authorization.
This synthesis read supplied text for physical pages 1–55 and all earlier page/image notes. Earlier API calls received the images; this synthesis did not directly inspect images.
Batch-local statements about unavailable pages in earlier notes are not combined-packet omissions. Their uncertainties were reconsidered using the complete supplied text.
Source hash, path, availability, and page-call receipts are supplied provenance, not independently recomputed/accessed artifacts.

All 128 operational feature definitions were considered. Assertions 001–128 cover the catalogue; 129–134 separately preserve unresolved implementation; 135 addresses broader paper-level causal assurance.
Transition-dependent inapplicability is scoped to the inspected diagnostic mechanism, not inferred merely from article type or an unreported parent.
Relevant safety, privacy, calibration, human-use, and utility gaps remain not_reported rather than absent.
R0 follows explicit conceptual/non-software statements. No own R1–R8 evidence is inherited from cited experiments/devices; R2 requires held-out actual human/clinical data.
No own trained ModelVersion, operational ModuleImplementation, clinical cohort, predictive EvaluationRun, or model-performance MetricResult is invented.
Scenario counts, hypothetical risks, and external-study summaries are not this proposal's clinical validation. Review calculations appear only as review findings.
Cited articles, repositories, regulatory inventories, supplements, and the original workbook were not independently accessed.
No programmatic schema, quotation, reference, graph, regression, or filesystem validation was executed.
